source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), Questions and answers, record date share count
source.quote: We had 3,031,501,149 shares of common stock outstanding and entitled to vote on the record date, September 21, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as ORCL. The count is the 2026 proxy's record-date figure (September 21, 2026), newer than the Q1 FY2027 10-Q cover (3,023,736,000 at September 7, 2026); both include the 141 million shares issued through the at-the-market program in the quarter ended August 31, 2026. The 50,000 shares of 6.50% Series D Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock (issued February 5, 2026) are preferred stock and are left out.
